body:
Threat construction now returns `AuthoredThreatResult<Combatant>` and preserves unknown-threat, weapon-timing and sidearm-construction failures, including the weapon recipe’s validation errors. The sidearm no longer uses `expect`. Mission/encounter reducers and simulator bootstrap retain these causes.

The pinned SpacetimeDB SDK accepts `Result<(), E>` where `E: Display`, so reducers keep the typed error and the SDK renders it at the runtime boundary. No first-party `String` adapter is needed.

The shared weapon constructor also serves the iteration roster. Timeline and fatigue evidence now retain timing, performance and battle-resolution causes through the native command’s error. This is published in `596fb3b8778c1461a7831ea1adb65262c9caa933`; [current-head hosted checks](https://github.com/adventure-simulator-group/fabelgeist/pull/774/checks) are pending.
